name: qris-pg
description: Minimal QRIS payment gateway kit for Cloudflare Workers (static→dynamic + GoBiz mutasi + WebUI)

scripts.db:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute qris-pg --local --file=$f || exit 1; done
scripts.db:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute qris-pg --remote --file=$f || exit 1; done
